arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
echo '--- OLLAMA_LAUNCH_FILES ---'
for f in "$BASE/run-ollama.sh" "$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then stat -c '%n size=%s mtime=%y mode=%a' "$f"; sha256sum "$f"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f"; else echo "MISSING $f"; fi
done
echo '--- OLLAMA_ENV_SOURCE_MATCHES ---'
find "$BASE" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.env' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.conf' -o -name '*.service' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.md' \) \
  ! -path "$BASE/envs/*" ! -path "$BASE/miniconda/*" ! -path "$BASE/openwebui-data/*" ! -path "$BASE/.ollama/*" \
  -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 grep -nH -E 'OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|CONTEXT_LENGTH|NUM_THREAD)|\.ollama-keepalive|qwen2\.5-coder:1\.5b-instruct-q4_K_M' 2>/dev/null | head -220 || true
echo '--- KEEPALIVE_DIR ---'
find "$BASE/.ollama-keepalive" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p size=%s mtime=%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
echo '--- KEEPALIVE_LOG_TAIL ---'
tail -100 "$BASE/.ollama-keepalive/keepalive.log" 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- RELEVANT_PROCESSES ---'
ps -eo pid,ppid,lstart,etime,%cpu,%mem,rss,args | grep -Ei '[o]llama serve|[l]lama-server|[o]llama.*keepalive|[e]nsure.*ollama|[q]wen2\.5-coder' || true
echo '--- USER_CRON_RELEVANT ---'
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -Ei 'ollama|keepalive' || true
echo '--- OLLAMA_DAEMON_ENV ---'
pid="$(pgrep -f '/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/miniconda/bin/ollama serve' | head -n1 || true)"
if [ -n "$pid" ] && [ -r "/proc/$pid/environ" ]; then
  echo "PID=$pid"
  tr '\0' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/environ" | grep '^OLLAMA_' | sort || true
fi
